meta.source: Manual_Didactica_Universitaria.docx (Word styles and direct formatting), revised by the v2 typography, colour and contrast audit (see README, Audit). Brand hues kept from the source; screen sizes raised for reading.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Brand navy (source). Unit titles (h1), cover title, glossary terms, table header fill in light theme. Text on `paper`, `surface` and every box surface.

tokens.name: azure
tokens.usage: Brand azure (source). Section and sub-section headings (h2, h3), chapter kicker, cover kicker. Text on `paper`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body copy, lists, table cells. Text on `paper`, `surface`, `band` and every box surface (≥ 13:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: table and figure notes, cover lede, diagram captions. Text on `paper` and `surface` (≥ 7:1).

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Screen backdrop behind pages; diagram node fill.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines: table rows, running-header underline, box header divider. Decorative.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Lines that carry meaning: diagram connectors and arrows, table top and bottom rules (≥ 3:1 on `paper`).

tokens.name: table-head
tokens.usage: Table header row fill. Pair with `on-table-head`.

tokens.name: on-table-head
tokens.usage: Header-cell text on `table-head`; text on `diagram-node-strong`.

tokens.name: band
tokens.usage: Zebra fill on even table rows; row-header cells of concept tables.

tokens.name: running
tokens.usage: Running header and footer. Text on `paper` (5.6:1; the source #8090A8 was 3.2:1).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links and DOIs, underlined. Text on `paper` and box surfaces.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring on links and controls (≥ 3:1 on `paper` and every box surface).

tokens.name: keypoints-accent
tokens.usage: “Puntos Clave” box: title, icon, bullet markers. Text on `keypoints-surface`.

tokens.name: keypoints-surface
tokens.usage: “Puntos Clave” box fill.

tokens.name: keypoints-border
tokens.usage: “Puntos Clave” box frame and header divider.

tokens.name: objectives-accent
tokens.usage: “Objetivos” box: title, icon, Bloom tags. Text on `objectives-surface`.

tokens.name: objectives-surface
tokens.usage: “Objetivos” box fill.

tokens.name: objectives-border
tokens.usage: “Objetivos” box frame, Bloom tag outline.

tokens.name: important-accent
tokens.usage: “Importante” box: title, icon, defined term. Text on `important-surface`.

tokens.name: important-surface
tokens.usage: “Importante” box fill.

tokens.name: important-border
tokens.usage: “Importante” box frame.

tokens.name: mistake-accent
tokens.usage: “Error Frecuente” box: title, icon, the misconception label. Text on `mistake-surface`.

tokens.name: mistake-surface
tokens.usage: “Error Frecuente” box fill.

tokens.name: mistake-border
tokens.usage: “Error Frecuente” box frame.

tokens.name: thinking-accent
tokens.usage: “Para Seguir Pensando” box: title, icon, question numbers. Text on `thinking-surface`.

tokens.name: thinking-surface
tokens.usage: “Para Seguir Pensando” box fill.

tokens.name: thinking-border
tokens.usage: “Para Seguir Pensando” box frame.

tokens.name: activities-accent
tokens.usage: “Actividades” box: title, icon, task numbers and type tags. Text on `activities-surface`.

tokens.name: activities-surface
tokens.usage: “Actividades” box fill.

tokens.name: activities-border
tokens.usage: “Actividades” box frame.

tokens.name: references-accent
tokens.usage: “Referencias” box: title and icon. Text on `references-surface`.

tokens.name: references-surface
tokens.usage: “Referencias” box fill.

tokens.name: references-border
tokens.usage: “Referencias” box frame.

tokens.name: diagram-node
tokens.usage: Diagram node fill (concept web branches, cycle and flow steps). Text `ink`.

tokens.name: diagram-node-border
tokens.usage: Diagram node outline (≥ 2.5:1 on `paper`; the label carries the meaning).

tokens.name: diagram-node-strong
tokens.usage: Central or emphasised node fill. Text `on-table-head`.

tokens.name: ramp-1
tokens.usage: Pyramid/level ramp, top (most advanced) level. Text `on-table-head`.

tokens.name: ramp-2
tokens.usage: Pyramid ramp, level 2. Text `on-table-head`.

tokens.name: ramp-3
tokens.usage: Pyramid ramp, level 3. Text `ink`.

tokens.name: ramp-4
tokens.usage: Pyramid ramp, base level. Text `ink`.

families.serif: Cambria, Caladea, Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif

styles.name: cover-subtitle
styles.sample: Fundamentos, estrategias y evaluación para la docencia universitaria

styles.name: cover-lede
styles.sample: Con desarrollos de didáctica general y de las didácticas específicas

styles.name: ribbon
styles.sample: Material de estudio para la formación del profesorado universitario

styles.name: chapter-kicker
styles.usage: Chapter number above the unit title, `azure`, upper case.

styles.name: h1
styles.sample: Teorías del aprendizaje en la educación superior

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Vygotsky (1978, p. xx) desplazó el foco desde el individuo hacia la matriz social del aprendizaje.
styles.usage: Default paragraph, `ink`; left-aligned on screen, justified in print; `space-3` after.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Toda decisión de enseñanza descansa en una teoría acerca de cómo aprenden las personas.
styles.usage: Opening paragraph of a unit under the title, `ink`.

styles.name: list-item
styles.sample: Diseñar una propuesta de enseñanza alineada.

styles.name: box-body
styles.sample: Franja entre el nivel de desarrollo real y el potencial.

styles.name: blockquote
styles.sample: La buena enseñanza es aquella que…
styles.usage: APA-7 block quotation (40 words or more): indented `indent-hang`, no quotation marks, citation after the final period.

styles.name: glossary
styles.sample: Andamiaje: Apoyo temporal que ofrece el docente…

styles.name: reference
styles.sample: Bain, K. (2004). What the best college teachers do. Harvard University Press.
styles.usage: APA-7 reference with a French (hanging) indent `indent-hang`; titles italic.

styles.name: table-title
styles.sample: Teorías del aprendizaje e implicancias didácticas
styles.usage: APA-7 table/figure title, italic, on the line under “Tabla N” / “Figura N”.

styles.name: note
styles.sample: Nota. Elaboración propia a partir de Ausubel (1968, p. xx).

styles.name: box-title
styles.usage: Box title next to its icon, upper case, in the box's `*-accent`.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Bloom level and activity-type tags, upper case.

styles.name: table-number
styles.usage: APA-7 table/figure number, bold, above the title.

styles.name: diagram-title
styles.usage: Central node and step titles in diagrams.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Table cell padding (vertical); tag padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: List item and h3 space after; icon–title gap; cell padding (horizontal).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Paragraph space after; box header padding; h2 space after.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Box body padding; h1 space after; gap between diagram nodes.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Space around boxes, tables and figures; h3 space before.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: h1 and h2 space before.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Chapter opener padding; space between chapters.

tokens.name: indent-bullet
tokens.usage: Bullet position (0.25in); list text starts at `indent-hang`.

tokens.name: indent-hang
tokens.usage: French (hanging) indent of references and block-quote indent (0.5in, APA 7).

tokens.name: page-margin
tokens.usage: Page margins (1in) on wide screens and print.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Text-block width (about 72 characters of `body`).

radius.note: Tables and rules stay square as in the source; boxes, tags and diagram nodes get a small radius for screen.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Tables, rules, page.

tokens.name: radius-box
tokens.usage: The seven boxes.

tokens.name: radius-node
tokens.usage: Diagram nodes.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Bloom and activity tags.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Table row rules, box frames and header dividers, running-header underline.

tokens.name: stroke-strong
tokens.usage: Table top/bottom rules, diagram connectors, focus ring.

tokens.name: stroke-ribbon
tokens.usage: Cover ribbon rules (1pt, source).

tokens.name: shadow-page
tokens.usage: Page sheet on the `surface` backdrop (screen only).
